title: VeriContaminated: Assessing LLM-Driven Verilog Coding for Data Contamination
authors_zh: Zeng Wang，Minghao Shao，Jitendra Bhandari，Likhitha Mankali，Ramesh Karri，Ozgur Sinanoglu，Muhammad Shafique，Johann Knechtel。
paper_type_zh: Verilog 代码生成基准的数据污染与评测可靠性审计
best_for_zh: 评估硬件代码生成模型、构建去污染基准或审计训练—测试泄漏的研究者。
one_line: Official repository releases the Verilog contamination-assessment implementation.
以双检测器审计 Verilog 评测污染，并量化缓解污染与代码质量的取舍。
why: It adds an auditable reliability or failure-mode surface to Track 13.
inclusion_reason: Track 13: contamination, verifier/reward failure, reward hacking, or evaluator reliability.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Verilog code-generation benchmarks can be memorized through pre-training or fine-tuning, making pass@k look like hardware-design ability. This risk has been studied in software but not systematically in RTL, leaving benchmark rankings and industrial adoption hard to trust.

The paper audits VerilogEval and RTLLM with two contamination detectors, then deliberately fine-tunes a controllable model and studies TED filtering. It produces a hardware-domain contamination diagnosis and mitigation trade-off, not a new code generator.

Verilog 代码生成基准可能被预训练或微调记忆，令 pass@k 看起来像硬件设计能力。软件领域已有污染研究，RTL 却缺少系统审计，因而基准排名与工业采用的可信度均不明确。

论文以两种检测器审计 VerilogEval 和 RTLLM，再有控制地微调模型并研究 TED 过滤，产出硬件领域的污染诊断与缓解权衡，而不是新的代码生成器。

由于硬件训练语料相对稀缺，训练—测试重合尤其可能把记忆误读为设计泛化。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The core object is a two-detector audit contract for RTL benchmark results: CDD tests repeated token-level output patterns across samples, while Min-K% Prob uses low-probability tokens. The paper contrasts their thresholds with functional pass rates, then applies TED to remove likely memorized samples. The public repository is a notebook implementation; it is not a released new Verilog training dataset.

核心对象是 RTL 基准结果的双检测器审计契约：CDD 检查多次输出中重复的 token 级模式，Min-K% Prob 检查低概率 token。论文将其阈值与功能 pass rate 对照，再以 TED 移除可能记忆的样本。公开仓库是 notebook 实现，不是发布新的 Verilog 训练数据集。

它同时覆盖闭源、开源和微调模型，避免把某个高分直接解释为独立的真实泛化能力。

污染判断需与性能共同阅读。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Run benchmark samples. Generate 50 outputs per problem for RTLLM and VerilogEval from commercial and open models, retaining probabilities and pass@k.
  1. Detect contamination. Apply CDD with similarity α and Min-K% Prob with K=20 and threshold T; each returns a contaminated-item rate, not ground-truth provenance.
  1. Control leakage. Fine-tune Llama-3.1-8B separately on RTLCoder and filtered Verigen (3 epochs, lr 1e-5) to create measurable contamination settings.
  1. Mitigate and compare. TED excludes the top τ% likely memorized outputs, then measures syntax/function pass-rate loss. Fix prompts, detector thresholds, samples, model API versions and benchmark revisions; these choices materially change the result.

1. 运行基准采样。 对 RTLLM、VerilogEval 每题生成 50 个输出，覆盖商用与开源模型，保留概率和 pass@k。
  1. 检测污染。 以相似度 α 运行 CDD、以 K=20 和阈值 T 运行 Min-K% Prob；两者输出的是疑似污染率，不是训练数据来源真值。
  1. 控制泄漏。 分别在 RTLCoder 与过滤后的 Verigen 上微调 Llama-3.1-8B（3 epoch、lr 1e-5），构造可测的污染情形。
  1. 缓解并比较。 TED 排除最可能记忆的前 τ% 输出，再测语法/功能损失。复现须固定提示、阈值、采样、API 版本和基准修订；这些选择会改变结果。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Claim. RTL benchmark results have material contamination risk, but its estimated level depends on detector and threshold.

Setup. Table I runs CDD (α=0.05) and Min-K% Prob (T=0.55) on RTLLM and VerilogEval across 12 models and reports pass rate; therefore the experiment compares detector signals, not verified training-corpus overlap.

Result. GPT-4o is 100.00% CDD-contaminated on both benchmarks and 98.00/99.36% under Min-K%, with RTLLM/VerilogEval pass rates 44.00/60.26%. GPT-3.5 is likewise near 100%, while estimates diverge substantially for other models.

Boundary. This supports an audit warning, not proof that every detected item was trained on; detector sensitivity and benchmark prompting are acknowledged confounders.

主张。 RTL 基准结果存在实质污染风险，但估计水平取决于检测器和阈值。

设置。 表 I 以 CDD（α=0.05）和 Min-K% Prob（T=0.55）在两个基准、12 个模型上审计并报告 pass rate；比较的是检测信号，不是对训练语料重叠的直接证实。

结果。 GPT-4o 在两个基准的 CDD 均为 100.00%，Min-K% 为 98.00/99.36%，pass rate 为 44.00/60.26%。GPT-3.5 同样近 100%，其它模型两种估计显著分歧。

边界。 这支持预警，不能证明每项都进入训练；检测敏感性和提示词是混杂因素。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Prior contamination work concentrates on natural-language or software code benchmarks. This paper transfers two existing detectors and TED into VerilogEval/RTLLM, adds controlled RTL fine-tuning, and makes the fairness-versus-functional-accuracy trade-off observable. The detectors and mitigation are not new; the contribution is their hardware-specific audit and evidence that prompt/test design changes the estimate.

既有污染研究多聚焦自然语言或软件代码基准。本文把两种既有检测器和 TED 迁入 VerilogEval/RTLLM，加入受控 RTL 微调，使公平性与功能准确率的权衡可观察。检测器和缓解器并非新技术；新意是硬件专项审计及提示/测试设计会改变估计的证据。

相较只报 pass@k 的常规榜单，它先追问高分是否由泄漏造成，并量化去污染的质量代价。

这使排名的解释对象从分数扩展到数据谱系。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The authors state that CDD and Min-K% Prob were designed for software, while RTL-specific detectors are missing; their estimates diverge and cannot establish provenance. TED lowers contamination but can lower Verilog functionality, so a high filter threshold can turn a clean-looking evaluation into a less useful one.

Curator audit: commercial APIs and version drift make replicate estimates fragile. Before using a contamination label, preserve raw samples, thresholds, prompt templates, and a manually inspected subset rather than treating one detector score as fact.

作者明确指出 CDD、Min-K% Prob 原为软件设计，RTL 专项检测器缺失；两种估计会分歧，不能建立数据来源真值。TED 能降污染，却会降低 Verilog 功能准确率，高阈值可能使“更干净”的评测失去实用性。

编者审计：商用 API 与版本漂移使复现估计脆弱。使用污染标签前要保存原始样本、阈值、提示模板，并人工检查子集，不能把单一检测分数当事实。

不同检测器和阈值下的结果应并列报告，不能压缩成唯一污染真值。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: A hardware-LLM evaluator can reuse the notebook to audit a benchmark before publishing pass@k: supply prompts, reference tests, repeated generations and token probabilities; run both detectors; output a detector-disagreement report plus performance. Success requires stable findings under thresholds and manual checks. Do not use it to accuse a model of copying training data or to compare APIs without pinned versions.

硬件 LLM 评测者可在发布 pass@k 前复用 notebook 审计基准：提供提示、参考测试、重复生成和 token 概率，运行双检测器，输出检测分歧与性能报告。只有阈值扰动和人工抽检下结论稳定才算成功。不能据此指控模型复制训练数据，也不能在未固定 API 版本时比较。

发布排名时还应公开过滤阈值、移除比例及去污染后的功能指标，供后续复核。

同时保留检测器原始输出，方便敏感性分析。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Position: hardware-code benchmark contamination audit, not a Verilog generator.
  2. Lever: CDD and Min-K% Prob disagree by design; threshold sweeps are part of the result.
  3. Artifact: public notebook/code; no newly released training dataset is claimed.
  4. Evidence: GPT-4o CDD is 100% on both tests, but estimates vary across methods (Table I).
  5. Reuse: audit repeated outputs and token probabilities first; preserve threshold sensitivity and manual evidence.

1. 定位： 硬件代码基准污染审计，不是 Verilog 生成器。
  2. 方法抓手： CDD 与 Min-K% Prob 会有结构性分歧；阈值扫描本身是结果的一部分。
  3. 产物： 公开 notebook/代码；未声称发布新的训练数据。
  4. 证据： GPT-4o 在两基准的 CDD 均为 100%，但方法间估计不同（表 I）。
  5. 复用： 先审计重复输出与 token 概率；保留阈值敏感性和人工证据。
